title: Introduce a nitrogen chain
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Azide ion can replace bromide by SN2 substitution at a primary carbon. The displayed N₃ group is a condensed label for the azide group, not a single atom.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of bromoethane under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Bromoethane is treated with azide ion in a polar aprotic solvent. Which major organic product forms after workup? Azide ion can replace bromide by SN2 substitution at a primary carbon. The displayed N₃ group is a condensed label for the azide group, not a single atom.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
